findings.text: the second writer in the measured concurrency shape is refused by the version-conflict message at reckon/ledger.py:792, not by this node's guard at reckon/ledger.py:755, and the test asserts only that some LedgerError is raised, so it cannot detect a regression of the run-count refusal: with the declared mutation applied to a scratch copy of the reviewed tree it still passes, and only driving that writer with a current version makes the guard fire (measured: refused, committed run count from 4 to 1; the file keeps all four rows either way).

the figure path lies outside the four declared write paths, which matters because the fence is exclusive, though the standing graphic mandate names docs/figures and two sibling landing records in this plan wrote to the same directory, so this reads as a fence-definition gap for the coordinator rather than damage.

the run refusal compares counts where its sibling at reckon/ledger.py:664 compares ids, so a same-count substitution of every row passes unrefused (measured: a three-row ledger written back with three other run ids is accepted), which is a boundary rather than a defect because the goal names counts and the measured incident shrank 110 to 1.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against the base revision: ddd3b03b changes only reckon/ledger.py and tests/test_ledger_write_cannot_shrink.py, and the second changes the plan, the evidence record and one figure; the source hunk adds a run-count refusal gated on the version matching the stored one, plus one lazily imported helper naming the run store as the recovery.
item_verdicts.done_when: read the measure and ran it at 37fc6413, tests/test_ledger_write_cannot_shrink.py passing 9 of 9 unmutated; the run-count refusal, the omitted-runs-key refusal, the incident shape and the run-store naming are all genuinely asserted, and both converse probes are green under my own driver, an ordinary appending promotion appends and a same-count patch is accepted, but the concurrency clause is satisfied by a pre-existing check rather than by this node's guard (finding 1).
item_verdicts.goal: read the node prompt's goal line and the plan's section on a promotion destroying its own ledger, whose goal is that a write reducing the committed run count or the member count be refused naming both counts; driving ledger.write directly at the reviewed revision refuses a 110-run ledger written back as one row and refuses a three-member roster written back as one, each naming both counts, and each refusal names the run store as the recovery.
item_verdicts.manifest: read manifest.md at the target run directory (mtime 11:31:30), which records commit ddd3b03b, the 15-file cohort at 18 failures before and 18 after, and the log paths; its negative_control_log field is empty there, and the mutation is recorded instead in regcount-negative-control.log, whose first line repeats the declared mutation verbatim and whose test line is a single failure.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the node manifest's declared four paths against a five-path diff; reckon/ledger.py, tests/test_ledger_write_cannot_shrink.py, docs/plans/scoring-should-stop-a-promotion.html and docs/evidence/archive/scoring-should-stop-a-promotion-landed.html are all inside the fence, and docs/figures/ledger-write-cannot-shrink/guard_flow.svg is the only path outside it (finding 2).

justifications.durability: tests/test_ledger_write_cannot_shrink.py:65 fails DID NOT RAISE once the refusal is removed, so a regression of the guard is loud rather than silent.
justifications.evidence: five of the nine tests in tests/test_ledger_write_cannot_shrink.py go red under this node's declared mutation (measured on a scratch copy: 5 failed, 4 passed), but the concurrency test the done_when names stays green because the refusal it sees comes from reckon/ledger.py:792 rather than from the new guard.
justifications.fit: the new refusal mirrors the roster guard at reckon/ledger.py:746 in shape, message register and flag handling, and the helper at reckon/ledger.py:674 is named by mechanism with the store import kept lazy.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:755 refuses the reduction before the payload is written, and the two refusals named are the only two shapes the goal names.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff is a small guarded block in reckon/ledger.py plus a 220-line test file and the two declared docs, with one figure path outside the fence after two sibling landing records in this plan wrote there too.
